mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_type (name, bed_count, price, introduction, photo, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{bedCount}, #{price}, #{introduction}, #{photo}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT rt.id, rt.name, rt.bed_count, rt.price, rt.introduction, rt.photo, rt.status, rt.create_time, rt.update_time, rt.create_by, rt.update_by, rt.remark, COUNT(r.id) AS room_count FROM room_type rt LEFT JOIN room r ON r.type_name = rt.name AND r.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY rt.id

SELECT rt.id, rt.name, rt.bed_count, rt.price, rt.introduction, rt.photo, rt.status, rt.create_time, rt.update_time, rt.create_by, rt.update_by, rt.remark, COUNT(r.id) AS room_count FROM room_type rt LEFT JOIN room r ON r.type_name = rt.name AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rt.status = #{status} GROUP BY rt.id

SELECT rt.id, rt.name, rt.bed_count, rt.price, rt.introduction, rt.photo, rt.status, rt.create_time, rt.update_time, rt.create_by, rt.update_by, rt.remark, COUNT(r.id) AS room_count FROM room_type rt LEFT JOIN room r ON r.type_name = rt.name AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rt.name = #{typeName} GROUP BY rt.id
